definitions.gloss: monthly calendar; page-a-month calendar; wall calendar with one page per month
definitions.explanation: A calendar format where each month has its own page, typically hung on a wall and flipped or torn off at the end of each month. The most common type of wall calendar in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{月|つき}めくり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カレンダー→カレンダー：02897_karendaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掛|か}けた。
examples.english: I hung a monthly calendar on the wall.

examples.japanese: {月|つき}めくり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧めくって、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I turned the page of the monthly calendar and checked the schedule for the new month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{月|つき}めくり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カレンダー→カレンダー：02897_karendaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{配|くば}られる→配る：03921_kubaru⟧。
examples.english: At year's end, the company distributes monthly wall calendars.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧ (month) and めくり (turning/flipping pages, from ⟦{捲|めく}る→捲る：02310_mekuru⟧). The word describes the format of the calendar rather than its content.

In Japan, companies and organizations commonly give out {月|つき}めくり calendars as year-end gifts to clients and employees. These are a ubiquitous part of Japanese office and home life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月|つき}めくり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カレンダー→カレンダー：02897_karendaa⟧: a page-a-month calendar
- {壁掛|かべか}け{月|つき}めくり: wall-hanging monthly calendar
- {月|つき}めくり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧めくる: to turn the page on the monthly calendar

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{日|ひ}めくり→日めくり：19045_himekuri⟧: daily tear-off calendar — one page per day
- ⟦{卓上|たくじょう}→卓上：22894_takujou⟧⟦カレンダー→カレンダー：02897_karendaa⟧: desk calendar — placed on a desk rather than hung
- ⟦カレンダー→カレンダー：02897_karendaa⟧: calendar — general term for any calendar
